content: Middleware's real job with Supabase SSR is silently refreshing expired session cookies on every request, not just route-guarding. Must use @supabase/ssr (auth-helpers is deprecated), and the updated cookies from the Supabase server client must be explicitly copied onto the outgoing NextResponse in middleware or the refreshed session is dropped and users get logged out. Mixing server client (Server Components) and browser client (Client Components) incorrectly causes hydration/session desync.
